title: Shock in Queensborough (71103) : Woman Beats Man to Death With Hammer, Leaves Note - INVESTIGATION UNDERWAY
text:
Queensborough (71103) – A chilling homicide has shaken the quiet Queensborough neighborhood after police say a woman bludgeoned a man to death with a hammer and left a handwritten note on his chest before fleeing the scene.
Credit: @ShreveportEyes Authorities were called to a home in the 1700 block of Milam Street around 9:45 PM on Sunday after a neighbor reported loud banging and screaming. When officers arrived, they found the body of 41-year-old Darnell Jacobs lying on the living room floor, covered in blood with severe head trauma . A hammer, believed to be the murder weapon, was recovered at the scene.
Key Facts BREAKING/NEW DEVELOPMENT: Tasha Collins arrested for hammer killing in Shreveport home
IMPACT: Victim Darnell Jacobs, 41, found dead with note on chest
OFFICIAL SOURCE: “This was calculated and brutal.” – Chief Wayne Smith
ACTION: Neighbors urged to report any previous domestic violence concerns
A disturbing note —written in black ink—was placed on Jacobs’ chest. Investigators have not released the full contents of the message but confirmed it was “personal and targeted.”
The suspect, identified as Tasha Renée Collins , 36, of Shreveport, was arrested Monday morning at a bus terminal in Monroe. According to police, she had plans to leave the state.
Hyperlocal Impact Precise Location : Queensborough (71103) – Near 1700 block of Milam Street, close to Ingleside Park
Community Connection : “He was always smiling. This shook us. It could’ve been anyone’s brother.” – LaToya Freeman , owner of Freeman’s Deli on Milam
Detectives say the two had a prior romantic relationship that ended in a violent dispute earlier this year. Collins faces first-degree murder charges and is being held without bond at the Caddo Correctional Center.
“This was not a random act of violence,” said Police Chief Wayne Smith. “It was calculated and brutal.”
The neighborhood remains in shock as crime scene investigators continue combing through evidence.
A candlelight vigil for Jacobs is being organized by family and community members for Wednesday evening.
Exclusive Angle WHY THIS MATTERS NOW : This is the third domestic-related homicide in Shreveport this summer , highlighting a disturbing trend in intimate partner violence . Local advocacy groups are now calling for more mental health and anger management resources in high-risk areas like Queensborough.
Update Log 12:45 PM : Collins booked into Caddo Correctional, bond denied
9:30 AM : SPD confirms handwritten note recovered
6:00 AM : Police confirm Collins’ arrest in Monroe
